blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Sibol kissed its gold medal hopes goodbye in the Mobile Legends: Bang Bang esports event of the Asian Games 2026 after a shocking quarterfinal loss to Indonesia, 1-2, on Wednesday at Aichi Sky Expo. The Philippines, represented by the core of four-time Mobile Legends Professional League (MPL) Philippines champion Team Liquid, struggled to establish its footing as Indonesia’s aggressive start repeatedly disrupted Sibol’s plans throughout the series. Despite dropping the first game, Sibol bounced back strong in Game 2, weathering the early-game pressure that had hounded […]...
